a: Gene expression is the process of using a gene to make a product.
Operons coordinate expression of gene groups in prokaryotes.
Epigenetic changes affect expression without altering DNA sequence.
Stem cells can self-renew and differentiate into other cell types.
Tissues form organs; organs form organ systems.
The circulatory system transports blood, nutrients, and gases.
The respiratory system exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide.
The digestive system breaks down food and absorbs nutrients.
The nervous system processes information via neurons.
The endocrine system uses hormones for longer-range signaling.
